files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Recipes entered in percentages: a "Baked weight" box, to ask for dough balls by the weight of the baked bread (for example 4 baguettes of 280 g); the raw dough is worked out with the baking loss of the recipe (measured on its bakes, otherwise the preferences) (web and Android).
- Bakes: the "Balling" step reminds how to divide the dough, for example "Divide into 4 dough balls of 250 g each" (raw dough per ball, weighed if the dough was weighed, otherwise expected) (web and Android).

### Changed
- Steps: "Balling" comes before "Shaping" in the list of step types.
- Recipes: the way of entering the ingredients is a two-choice toggle, "Grams" (the app works out the hydration) or "Percentages" (the app works out the grams), instead of a list mentioning a "reverse mode" (web and Android).
- New recipes start in percentages (65 % hydration, 1.5 % salt) with "Baked weight" ticked; the weight per dough ball is no longer shown when entering grams, where it is not used (web and Android).
- Preferences: the default weight per dough ball is now a baked weight (1 kg for bread, 280 g for pizza by default); a preference left at the former raw-dough default (900 g, 250 g) takes the new one.
